display_long_description:
Gesture Play is an immersive educational game designed to teach you the American Sign Language (ASL) alphabet using advanced Hand Tracking technology. There are no buttons to press and no controllers to hold—just you and your hands in a virtual environment.

Whether you are a complete beginner looking to learn the basics or looking to test your reflex speed, Gesture Play adapts to your pace.

👐 KEY FEATURES

True Hand Tracking Experience total freedom. The game detects your fingers and gestures in real-time, allowing you to sign naturally. Supports both Left and Right-hand dominance.

Two Main Game Modes

Practice Mode: Learn the alphabet at your own pace. Perfect your form without time limits. Use intuitive Thumb Micro-Gestures (flicking your thumb left or right) to navigate between letters seamlessly.

Game Mode: Ready for a challenge?

Normal: A survival mode where accuracy matters. You have limited lives—miss too many signs, and it’s Game Over!

Infinite: An endless flow where the speed gradually increases. Great for building muscle memory without the pressure of "losing."

⚠️ IMPORTANT TRACKING NOTE To ensure a frustration-free experience, the letters J, M, N, P, Q, R, T, and U are currently excluded from the game. These specific signs involve complex finger overlapping (occlusion) that current consumer VR cameras cannot yet track reliably. We have focused on the signs that provide the most accurate and responsive feedback.

Start your sign language journey today with G
